messages:
Sana (PM): Dropping a new prototype for the capacity/config flow. Looking for quick UX + a11y pass. figma: https://figma.com/... (frame: Capacity flow v2)

Diego (Design): Love the simpler flow. Two thoughts: 1) Pool selector currently sorts alphabetically  we should default-sort by headroom then latency. 2) Min/Max inputs are cramped on mobile. Consider stacking on narrow screens.

Priya (Eng): Agree on sorting. Backend can return pools with headroom and median_ms. We should display: "pool-name · 3 free GPUs · 120ms" in dropdown. Also, clamp "max" to free_gpus + reserved to avoid API failures.

Jules (A11y): A11y checklist: - Pool dropdown: ensure option labels are fully readable by screenreaders (avoid truncation without aria-label). - SLO slider: announce percent and the mapped API field name (e.g., "Target success rate 95%" using aria-valuetext). - Tooltip icons need accessible name.

Sana (PM): Good catch @Jules. For clarity let's show the mapped API field as small muted text under the slider: "Maps to target_success_rate". Is that okay?

Diego (Design): Fine but keep it subtle. Copy tweak: change "Burst" label to "Burst capacity (temporary)" and add a billing hint: "billed per GPU-second" in the tooltip.

Priya (Eng): Implementation notes: 1) When min == max -> show "Fixed capacity" pill instead of an active range slider (reduces confusion). 2) If user selects a pool with insufficient nodes, show inline helper: "Increase org quota or pick a larger pool" with CTA to request increase. 3) API should error with 400 + field-level errors: {"max":"exceeds_pool_capacity"}.

Jules (A11y): Also: ensure keyboard step for min/max is 1. When slider is focusable, left/right arrows should change by 1% but plus/minus keys should also work. Provide live region updates when autoscale decisions change (role=status).

Sana (PM): UX request: add a small "guardrail" summary at top: e.g., "If SLO cannot be met within pool capacity, requests will failover to fallback model/routes". Could be collapsed by default.

Diego (Design): Visual: guardrail status chips -> green (ok), orange (constrained), red (breached). For 'At risk' state show tooltip: "Estimated error rate may exceed 5% at current SLO".

Priya (Eng): We can compute a conservative "risk" score server-side and surface it. Also recommend locking the submit button while we validate chosen pool headroom to prevent races. Return a clear error: "Selected pool only has X free GPUs; lower max or select another pool."

Jules (A11y): Contrast nits: the orange chip needs to meet 4.5:1 for small text. Also add visible focus outlines for chips and the pool dropdown.

Diego (Design): Microcopy: replace "Max" tooltip with "Autoscale ceiling: the upper bound the system may scale to". Replace "Min" with "Minimum reserved capacity (always available)".

Sana (PM): Action items: Diego to update responsive mocks and chips, Jules to run quick screenreader pass on updated prototype, Priya to draft API errors + validation flow. I'll consolidate and send to Eng PMs.

deploy-bot: new design uploaded by Diego (Design) -> figma.com/... :rocket:

Priya (Eng): I'll include sample responses and a short contract doc in the repo by Monday.

Jules (A11y): Will test with VoiceOver/ChromeVox Friday and post findings.

Diego (Design): Thanks all, will iterate and ping when done. :raised_hands:
